name: Maximilian Gruber
bio:
Maximilian's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood, spent watching Formula 1 races with his father. He pursued a degree in Mechanical Engineering at the Vienna University of Technology, specializing in vehicle dynamics. After graduating, he gained experience at a small racing team, analyzing telemetry data and contributing to vehicle setup. His meticulous approach to data analysis and problem-solving quickly made him a valuable asset.

Joining Team Gtechniq was a significant step in his career. Maximilian thrives on the pressure of optimizing performance and is known for his ability to translate complex data into actionable insights for the drivers and mechanics. He believes in a collaborative approach, fostering open communication within the team to identify areas for improvement. His dedication to precision and continuous learning makes him a rising star in the field.

Maximilian distinguishes himself through his unwavering focus on detail and his methodical approach. He is always searching for marginal gains, whether through refining aerodynamic setups or optimizing tire strategies. He understands that success in motorsport is often determined by the smallest of margins, and he is committed to finding those advantages for Team Gtechniq.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight side part.
physical.description: Maximilian is of average height with a lean build, often seen wearing glasses.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with calculations.
Has a habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Drinks exactly one large cup of black coffee at 10:00 AM every day.
